title: What is a CUDA kernel?
lead: GPU threads execute the instructions in hello.
note: The assignment writes one float to GPU memory.
captions: A CUDA kernel is a function that GPU threads execute.
In this file, global marks hello as a kernel.
The thread writes forty-two point zero at output index zero.

title: Launch one thread
lead: The CPU launches hello from main.
note: The two numbers describe how many threads to start.
captions: On the CPU, main reserves space in GPU memory for one float.
The first one requests one block. The second one requests one thread in that block.
The argument output gives the kernel the address of the float.

title: Where does the value go?
lead: One GPU thread runs the kernel and stores the result.
note: An SM is the part of the GPU that executes thread instructions.
captions: A streaming multiprocessor, or S M, executes instructions for the GPU thread.
The kernel stores forty-two point zero in GPU memory.
The CPU copies the value back, and main prints it in the console.

title: Change the stored value
lead: Which line determines what the console prints?
note: Try a new value in the editor.
captions: Change the value in the assignment, then compile and run again.
The launch still asks for one block and one thread.
Which value will main print this time?
